text:
alex_s: Heads-up — GammaHealth demo next Wed 09:30 PT. They want a live hosted API demo hitting our completions endpoint. Can we get a temporary quota bump and a scoped demo key?

maria_sol: What burst/profile do they need? sustained qps or just short spikes during a walkthrough?

alex_s: Mostly short spikes when they trigger workflows. Request: sustain ~100 rps for 30m, burst up to 300 rps for ~5m. Also need per-key metrics we can show in the Console (latency, token counts) and X-RateLimit headers so they see limits in the demo.

sam_oncall: Tagging infra — @ryan_infra can we do that on Hosted? 100->300 rps window is doable but need lead time.

ryan_infra: We can do a temporary exception on hosted scoped key. Two options:
- quick manual exception: create scoped key with timeboxed qps + token quota (need approver + ticket)
- create temp org entitlement (safer for larger sustained usage)
Either way we need: customer domain, POC owner email, exact timeframe (start/end UTC), and expected token/sec or req/sec. Also include whether they will use streaming.

maria_sol: They'll use streaming for live chat, and non-streaming for batch evals. I'll send sample payload sizes (avg 400 tokens per response).

alex_s: Can we also have the key limited to completions+embeddings only? Don't want them calling admin routes.

ryan_infra: Yes, we can scope it to routes. We'll create a key named poc-gamma-demo-2026 with route restrictions and a hard token cap. We'll also enable X-RateLimit headers and per-key reporting for the Console.

sam_oncall: FYI manual exception requires an SRE owner to monitor the window in-case of noisy traffic. I can take shifts during the demo if needed.

ops_bot: deploybot: created support ticket #INC-2026-4513 for temporary quota exception (pending approval).

alex_s: Thanks — what info should I put in the ticket so it moves quickly?

ryan_infra: Include: org_id, customer name (GammaHealth), demo start/end in UTC, requested qps/burst numbers, route restrictions, whether streaming enabled, contact for escalation (phone/email), and billing contact in case of overage. Mark as POC/demo and priority high.

maria_sol: Also attach the sample request rate script we run so infra can validate the simulated load (we use a ramp: 0->100 rps in 2m, sustain 30m, 5m burst to 300 rps). I'll paste it in the ticket.

alex_s: One more ask — can we have the scoped key rotate after the demo automatically? Security wants keys ephemeral.

ryan_infra: Yes, we can create it with a TTL and automatic revoke after N hours. We support TTLs for demo keys. Put desired TTL in the ticket.

alex_s: Demo is Wed 09:30 PT, so TTL should expire Wed 14:00 PT. I'll put that.

sam_oncall: If this is urgent (demo <24h), manual exception can be approved by infra leads. Add exec sponsor or sales director in the ticket to expedite.

alex_s: Got it — adding @maria_sol as POC owner, exec sponsor will be Dan S (sales director). I'll file ticket now and paste link here.

ops_bot: support: ticket #INC-2026-4513 updated: waiting for infra approval.

alex_s: Ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-4513 — included ramp script, payload sizes, and billing contact (billing@gammahealth.com).

ryan_infra: Received — I'll try to push approval. If we can't get the exception in time, fallback plan: run demo against a local Dedicated node we can stand up for the customer (higher OPEX) or record live run showing Console metrics.

maria_sol: Noted. Also need sample curl for them to sanity-check headers — can you paste?

ryan_infra: Sure, sample:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer poc-gamma-demo-2026" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"r2-large","input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions
```
Look for headers: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset and X-Request-Id.

alex_s: Perfect. I'll forward to GammaHealth and confirm they use the ramp script.

ops_bot: support: ticket #INC-2026-4513 status -> approved by infra lead; scoped key created: poc-gamma-demo-2026 (expires 2026-10-14T21:00:00Z).

alex_s: Amazing — thanks team. I'll add Sam to the calendar and send the key + curl snippet to the customer. :raised_hands:

ryan_infra: Leaving a note — if Gamma decides to extend POC beyond the demo, recommend moving to a short-term Dedicated pool. Hosted exceptions are timeboxed and not intended for sustained production traffic.

maria_sol: Copy. We'll flag that during post-demo follow-up.

alex_s: Closing loop here. If anything spikes during the demo ping #oncall.

sam_oncall: Will monitor. Good luck! :thumbsup:
